crops.text: Rots away after 4 turns.Creatures in the slot gain +2 SPD and, when performing an attack, take 2 piercing CDMG for every 4 SPD they have. Upon dealing CDMG, this item is sent to a different random creature slot.Any creature who is able to eat food may choose to eat this on their turn, removing it from the field and becoming inflicted with 4T Withering.
